records.subject: You're in -- let's get River Dynamics set up
records.body:
Hi Leo,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: :tada: New signup: *River Dynamics* just joined on the pro plan!

decisions.rationale: First project hit on day 0 (fast start) and kickoff held [calendar:0f72dd90], but no reply to welcome email [email:15022b08], no invites sent in 6 days, and no tickets. Momentum appears to have stopped after setup; 8 days left gives some chance of self-serve progress.

draft.subject: Next step after our kickoff
draft.body:
Hi Leo,

Thanks again for the kickoff call last week -- good to get a picture of how River Dynamics wants to work in Wrenfield.

You've got your first project in place, which is the main thing. Since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, the usual next step is getting a teammate in alongside you -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Want me to walk through that first invite with you on a short call this week?

Best,
Priya
